plugin.name: Translation_Mode
plugin.author: Mush-Z translation prototype
plugin.purpose: Asynchronous contextual translation bridge for Mush-Z

muclient.script:
local function tm_debug(msg) end
PLUGIN_ID = "c7b37d98c8e34df68f4e50a1" MUSHREADER_ID = "925cdd0331023d9f0b8f05a7" enabled = false review_mode = false pending = {} pending_ticks = 0 pending_target_ticks = 3 seq = 0 requests = {} recovery_requested = false base = (GetInfo(67):gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or GetInfo(67)) .. "/plugins/translation_bridge" inbox = base .. "/inbox" outbox = base .. "/outbox" worker = base .. "/translation_worker.py" logfile = GetInfo(67) .. "/translation_plugin.log" configfile = base .. "/translation_config.json" update_status_file = base .. "/translation_update_status.txt" debug_logging = false accessible_history_mode = "all" update_notice_spoken = false
local unicode_history = {} local unicode_history_pos = 0 local unicode_history_limit = 1000 local unicode_history_seq = 0 local history_follow_tail = true local block_starts = { ["You know the following skills:"] = "skills", ["You are carrying:"] = "inventory", ["The following items are available for sale at this time:"] = "shop_items", ["The following spell castings may be purchased for a small fee:"] = "shop_spells", ["The following items are currently up for grabs:"] = "free_items" } local active_block = nil local pending_categories = {} local block_diag = {starts=0,skills=0,inventory=0,carried_container=0,ground_container=0,shop_items=0,shop_spells=0,free_items=0,history=0} local outgoing_request_id = nil
local function block_category_for_line(line) local exact = block_starts[line] if exact then return exact end if line:find("carried contains:", 1, true) then return "carried_container" end if line:find("on ground contains:", 1, true) then return "ground_container" end return nil end
local function load_debug_setting() local f = io.open(configfile, "rb") if not f then return false end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() return text:match('"debug_logging"%s*:%s*true') ~= nil end
local function load_accessible_history_mode() local f = io.open(configfile, "rb") if not f then return "all" end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() local mode = text:match('"accessible_history_mode"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if mode == "off" or mode == "skills" or mode == "all" then return mode end return "all" end
local function translation_auto_start_enabled() local value = GetVariable("translation_auto_start") -- New installations start in Translation Mode automatically. Once the -- player chooses on or off, the plugin's saved state preserves that choice. if value == nil or value == "" then SetVariable("translation_auto_start", "1") return true end return value ~= "0" end
local function cloud_api_candidate_status() local paths = {base .. "/translate_api.txt", base .. "/translate api.txt"} for _, path in ipairs(paths) do local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() text = text:gsub("^\239\187\191", "") local value = nil local count = 0 for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do line = line:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if line ~= "" and not line:find("^#") then count = count + 1 local label, candidate = line:match("^([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if label then label = label:upper() if label ~= "GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY" and label ~= "API_KEY" then return "invalid", path end value = candidate else value = line end end end if count == 1 and value and #value >= 20 and #value <= 200 and not value:find("[^%w_%-]") then return "candidate", path end return "invalid", path end end return "missing", nil end
local function log(msg, critical) if not debug_logging and not critical then return end local f = io.open(logfile, "ab") if f then f:write(os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") .. " [PLUGIN] " .. tostring(msg) .. "\r\n") f:close() end end local function clean(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("\r", " "):gsub("\n", " ") return s end local speech_seq = 0 local session_id = string.format("%010d_%010d", os.time(), math.floor(os.clock() * 1000000) % 10000000000) local session_file = base .. "\\mush_session_" .. session_id .. ".alive" local review_state_file = (os.getenv("TEMP") or base) .. "\\mushz_translation_review_mode.txt" local review_entry_file = (os.getenv("TEMP") or base) .. "\\mushz_translation_review_entry.txt" local function touch_session_file() local f = io.open(session_file, "wb") if f then f:write(tostring(os.time())); f:close() end end local function remove_session_file() os.remove(session_file) end local function set_review_mode_state(active) review_mode = active and true or false if not review_mode then os.remove(review_state_file) os.remove(review_entry_file) os.remove(review_entry_file .. ".tmp") return end local tmp = review_state_file .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end f:write(session_file .. "\r\n") f:close() os.remove(review_state_file) os.rename(tmp, review_state_file) end local function write_review_entry(entry) if not review_mode then return end local text = type(entry) == "table" and entry.text or entry if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end local tmp = review_entry_file .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end if type(entry) == "table" and (entry.review_kind == "quest" or entry.review_kind == "job" or entry.review_kind == "skills") then f:write(string.char(30) .. "TMREVIEW:" .. entry.review_kind .. string.char(30)) end f:write(text); f:close() os.remove(review_entry_file) os.rename(tmp, review_entry_file) end local function speak(text, order_id) if not text or text == "" then return end speech_seq = speech_seq + 1 local hex = (text:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02X", string.byte(c)) end)) local world_dir = GetInfo(67) or "" local worlds_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or world_dir local inbox = worlds_dir .. "\\plugins\\translation_bridge\\speech_inbox" local name = order_id or string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, speech_seq) local tmp, final = inbox .. "\\" .. name .. ".tmp", inbox .. "\\" .. name .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end f:write(hex); f:close(); os.rename(tmp, final) end
local function history_trim() while #unicode_history > unicode_history_limit do table.remove(unicode_history, 1) unicode_history_pos = math.max(0, unicode_history_pos - 1) end end local function history_add(text, review_kind) if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end local follow = history_follow_tail or #unicode_history == 0 unicode_history_seq = unicode_history_seq + 1 local entry = {id=unicode_history_seq, text=text, review_kind=review_kind} unicode_history[#unicode_history + 1] = entry history_trim() if follow then unicode_history_pos = #unicode_history end return entry.id end local function history_insert_before(anchor_id, texts, review_kind) if type(texts) ~= "table" or #texts == 0 then return end local selected_id = unicode_history[unicode_history_pos] and unicode_history[unicode_history_pos].id or nil local at = nil for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == anchor_id then at = i; break end end if not at then for _, text in ipairs(texts) do history_add(text, review_kind) end return end for offset, text in ipairs(texts) do unicode_history_seq = unicode_history_seq + 1 table.insert(unicode_history, at + offset - 1, {id=unicode_history_seq, text=text, review_kind=review_kind}) end history_trim() if selected_id then for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == selected_id then unicode_history_pos = i; return end end end unicode_history_pos = #unicode_history end local function history_speak(entry) local text = type(entry) == "table" and entry.text or entry if text and text ~= "" then write_review_entry(entry) speak(text) end end local function history_review(entry) if entry then write_review_entry(entry) end end function TranslationHistoryPrevious() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.max(1, unicode_history_pos - 1); history_follow_tail = false; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryNext() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.min(#unicode_history, unicode_history_pos + 1); history_follow_tail = unicode_history_pos == #unicode_history; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryTop() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=1; history_follow_tail = false; history_speak(unicode_history[1]) end function TranslationHistoryBottom() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=#unicode_history; history_follow_tail = true; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryPreviousReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.max(1, unicode_history_pos - 1); history_follow_tail = false; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryNextReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.min(#unicode_history, unicode_history_pos + 1); history_follow_tail = unicode_history_pos == #unicode_history; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryTopReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=1; history_follow_tail = false; history_review(unicode_history[1]) end function TranslationHistoryBottomReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=#unicode_history; history_follow_tail = true; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end
local function remove_revealed_originals() local selected_id = unicode_history[unicode_history_pos] and unicode_history[unicode_history_pos].id or nil for i = #unicode_history, 1, -1 do if unicode_history[i].revealed_original then table.remove(unicode_history, i) if unicode_history_pos > i then unicode_history_pos = unicode_history_pos - 1 end end end if selected_id then for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == selected_id then unicode_history_pos = i; break end end end end
function TranslationRevealCurrentOriginal() if not review_mode or #unicode_history == 0 then return end local current = unicode_history[unicode_history_pos] if not current or current.revealed_original then return end local _, english = tostring(current.text or ""):match("^(.-)%s+|%s+([%s%S]*)$") english = tostring(english or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if english == "" then return end local source_id = current.id remove_revealed_originals() local source_pos = nil for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == source_id then source_pos = i; break end end if not source_pos then return end local insert_at = source_pos + 1 for i = source_pos + 1, #unicode_history do local value = tostring(unicode_history[i].text or "") if value:match("^出口：") or value:match("^門：") then insert_at = i break end end unicode_history_seq = unicode_history_seq + 1 local revealed = { id=unicode_history_seq, text=english:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " "), revealed_original=true, source_id=source_id } table.insert(unicode_history, insert_at, revealed) history_trim() for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == revealed.id then unicode_history_pos = i; break end end history_follow_tail = false write_review_entry(revealed) end function SpeakBlockDiagnostic() speak("block diagnostic. starts "..block_diag.starts..", skills "..block_diag.skills..", inventory "..block_diag.inventory.. ", carried "..block_diag.carried_container..", ground "..block_diag.ground_container..", shop items "..block_diag.shop_items.. ", shop spells "..block_diag.shop_spells..", free items "..block_diag.free_items..", history "..block_diag.history.. ", active "..tostring(active_block or "none")) end
local function b64(data) local chars='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/' return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) local r,bits='',x:byte() for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(bits%2^i-bits%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end return r end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x) if #x < 6 then return '' end local c=0 for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end return chars:sub(c+1,c+1) end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1]) end
function ClearRecentTranslationCache() if not enabled then speak("Translation mode is off.") return end seq = seq + 1 local request_id = string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, seq) local command = "__MUSHZ_CONTROL_CLEAR_RECENT_CACHE__:5" local tmp = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".tmp" local final = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then speak("Unable to request cache cleanup.") return end f:write(b64(command)); f:close() if not os.rename(tmp, final) then os.remove(tmp) speak("Unable to request cache cleanup.") return end requests[request_id] = {original="Cache cleanup failed.", ticks=0, categories={}, skip_history=true} end
function CheckApiUsage() if not enabled then speak("Translation mode is off. Turn it on before checking API usage.") return end seq = seq + 1 local request_id = string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, seq) local tmp = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".tmp" local final = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then speak("Unable to request API usage."); return end f:write(b64("__MUSHZ_CONTROL_CHECK_API__")); f:close() if not os.rename(tmp, final) then os.remove(tmp) speak("Unable to request API usage.") return end requests[request_id] = { original="API usage check failed.", ticks=0, categories={}, skip_history=true } speak("Checking API usage.") end
function TranslateOutgoingChatInput() if not enabled then speak("Translation mode is off.") return end if outgoing_request_id and requests[outgoing_request_id] then speak("Message translation is already in progress.") return end local command = tostring(GetCommand() or "") if command:find("^%s*$") then speak("The command input is empty.") return end seq = seq + 1 local request_id = string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, seq) local payload = "__MUSHZ_CONTROL_TRANSLATE_OUTGOING_CHAT__:" .. command local tmp = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".tmp" local final = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then speak("Unable to request message translation.") return end f:write(b64(payload)); f:close() if not os.rename(tmp, final) then os.remove(tmp) speak("Unable to request message translation.") return end requests[request_id] = { original=command, ticks=0, categories={}, skip_history=true, kind="outgoing_chat" } outgoing_request_id = request_id speak("Translating message.") end
local function file_exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close(); return true end return false end
local function start_update_check() os.remove(update_status_file) local script = base .. "\\check_translation_update.ps1" local version = base .. "\\translation_version.json" local windir = os.getenv("WINDIR") or "C:\\Windows" local powershell = windir .. "\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" if not file_exists(script) or not file_exists(version) or not file_exists(powershell) then return false end local params = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' .. script .. '" -VersionFile "' .. version .. '" -StatusFile "' .. update_status_file .. '"' local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(powershell, params, base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("update check launch failed=" .. tostring(err)) end return ok and true or false end
local function start_automatic_update(test_only) local helper = base .. "\\translation_update_helper.ps1" local windir = os.getenv("WINDIR") or "C:\\Windows" local powershell = windir .. "\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" if not file_exists(helper) or not file_exists(powershell) then utils.msgbox( "The automatic update helper was not found. Run translation_bridge\\update_translation.cmd manually.", "Translation Update", "ok", "!", 1 ) return false end local params = '-NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' .. helper .. '"' if test_only then params = params .. ' -TestOnly' end -- Keep the entire automatic update in the background so no console window -- can steal focus before or after ExitClient runs. local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(powershell, params, base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("automatic update helper launch failed=" .. tostring(err), true) utils.msgbox("The automatic update helper could not be started. MUSHclient will remain open.", "Translation Update", "ok", "!", 1) return false end speak("The update helper has started. Closing MUSHclient.") DoCommand("ExitClient") return true end
function TestAutomaticUpdatePrompt() local answer = utils.msgbox( "This tests the automatic update handoff.\r\n\r\n" .. "Choosing Yes will close MUSHclient normally and open the current NVDA add-on package. " .. "The test will not download or replace translation files.\r\n\r\nStart the test?", "Translation Update Test", "yesno", "?", 2 ) if answer == "yes" then start_automatic_update(true) end end
local function poll_update_notice() if update_notice_spoken then return end local f = io.open(update_status_file, "rb") if not f then return end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() local status = text:match("status=([^\r\n]+)") if status == "update" then local version = text:match("version=([^\r\n]+)") or "new" update_notice_spoken = true local answer = utils.msgbox( "Translation update " .. version .. " is available.\r\n\r\n" .. "Close MUSHclient now and install the update automatically?\r\n\r\n" .. "Choose No to keep the current version and update manually later.", "Translation Update", "yesno", "?", 2 ) if answer == "yes" then start_automatic_update(false) end elseif status == "current" or status == "error" then update_notice_spoken = true end end
local function start_worker() if not file_exists(worker) then log("ERROR worker file not found=" .. tostring(worker), true) return false end
local pythonw = base .. "/runtime/python/pythonw.exe" if not file_exists(pythonw) then local localapp = os.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA") or "" local candidates = { localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python310\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python311\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python312\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python313\\pythonw.exe" } for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do if file_exists(candidate) then pythonw = candidate; break end end end if not file_exists(pythonw) then log("ERROR portable or installed pythonw.exe not found", true) return false end
local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(pythonw, '"' .. worker .. '" "' .. session_file .. '"', base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("ERROR hidden worker launch failed=" .. tostring(err), true) end return ok and true or false end local speech_worker_started = false local function start_speech_worker() if speech_worker_started then return true end local world_dir = GetInfo(67) or "" local worlds_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or world_dir local script = worlds_dir .. "\\plugins\\translation_bridge\\nvda_speech_worker.ps1" local windir = os.getenv("WINDIR") or "C:\\Windows" local powershell = windir .. "\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" if not file_exists(script) or not file_exists(powershell) then return false end local params = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' .. script .. '"' local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(powershell, params, base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("ERROR hidden speech worker launch failed=" .. tostring(err), true) return false end speech_worker_started = true return true end
function OnPluginTick() touch_session_file() end
function OnPluginInstall() set_review_mode_state(false) touch_session_file() debug_logging = load_debug_setting() accessible_history_mode = load_accessible_history_mode() start_update_check() log("Translation Mode 0.8.1 THREE MODE REVIEW installed", true) log("base=" .. tostring(base)) log("worker=" .. tostring(worker)) Accelerator("ctrl+shift+t", "translation_toggle") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+pageup", "translation_history_previous") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+pagedown", "translation_history_next") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+home", "translation_history_top") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+end", "translation_history_bottom") -- Private silent history commands used by the NVDA app module. Direct -- Ctrl+Shift history hotkeys retain their original spoken behavior. Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+pageup", "translation_history_previous_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+pagedown", "translation_history_next_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+home", "translation_history_top_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+end", "translation_history_bottom_review") -- Translation Mode loads last and intentionally replaces output_functions' -- old Ctrl+Shift+Y "top line" binding with outgoing Chinese chat preview. Accelerator("ctrl+shift+y", "translation_translate_outgoing_chat") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+f8", "translation_block_diagnostic") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+delete", "translation_cache_clear_recent") tm_debug("TM DEBUG INSTALL: Translation Mode 0.6.0 loaded") if translation_auto_start_enabled() then log("automatic startup armed; waiting for MUD connection") end end
-- MUSHclient's own banner and plugin installation notes are emitted before a -- world connects. Starting here keeps those local diagnostics out of the -- bilingual game history while still enabling capture before the server sends -- Alter Aeon's welcome and character prompts. function OnPluginConnect() if translation_auto_start_enabled() and not enabled then if EnableTranslation(false) then log("automatic startup enabled translation mode on MUD connection") else log("ERROR automatic startup could not enable translation mode; English remains available", true) end end end
function EnableTranslation(announce) if enabled then return true end accessible_history_mode = load_accessible_history_mode() local api_status = cloud_api_candidate_status() if announce and api_status == "candidate" then Execute("tts_note Google Cloud API candidate found.") elseif api_status == "invalid" then log("Google Cloud API candidate file is invalid; using prototype fallback", true) if announce then Execute("tts_note Google Cloud API file invalid. Using standard translation.") end end if not start_speech_worker() then log("ERROR speech worker launcher not found or failed", true) if announce then Execute("tts_note Translation speech worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") end return false end -- Starting is idempotent: the worker lock rejects a duplicate process and -- recovers immediately when its previous owner crashed. do local ok, result = pcall(start_worker) if not ok then tm_debug("TM DEBUG ERROR: start_worker Lua error: " .. tostring(result)) log("ERROR start_worker Lua error=" .. tostring(result), true) if announce then Execute("tts_note Translation worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") end return false end if not result then if announce then Execute("tts_note Translation worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") end return false end end enabled = true -- Enabling always enters Chinese-screen review mode. The NVDA app module -- redirects numpad review to bilingual Translation Mode history. set_review_mode_state(true) if #unicode_history > 0 then write_review_entry(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end pending = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3 log("toggle enabled=true review_mode=true") if announce then Execute("tts_stop") Execute("tts_note Chinese review mode on.") end return true end
function SetTranslationAutoStart(name, line, wildcards) local value = clean((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):lower() if value == "on" or value == "1" or value == "yes" then SetVariable("translation_auto_start", "1") Execute("tts_note Translation automatic startup on.") elseif value == "off" or value == "0" or value == "no" then SetVariable("translation_auto_start", "0") Execute("tts_note Translation automatic startup off.") else Execute("tts_note Use translation underscore autostart on or off.") end end
function ScheduleTranslationBenchmark() local path = base .. "/benchmark_lmt_next_start.flag" local f = io.open(path, "wb") if not f then Execute("tts_note Unable to schedule L M T benchmark.") return end f:write("Run the full LMT backend benchmark once on the next worker start.\r\n") f:close() Execute("tts_note L M T benchmark scheduled. Restart Mush client when ready.") end
function ToggleTranslation() tm_debug("TM DEBUG 1: toggle entered")
if not enabled then EnableTranslation(true) else -- The only other state is off. Keep the old standard/English-screen -- translation mode out of the user-facing cycle. enabled = false set_review_mode_state(false) log("toggle enabled=false") pending = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3 for request_id,r in pairs(requests) do if r.original then speak(r.original, request_id) end end requests = {} Execute("tts_stop") Execute("tts_note Translation mode off.") end end
local exit_words = { n=true, s=true, e=true, w=true, u=true, d=true, ne=true, nw=true, se=true, sw=true, north=true, south=true, east=true, west=true, up=true, down=true, northeast=true, northwest=true, southeast=true, southwest=true, none=true }
local function strip_exit_heading(text) local patterns = { {"^exits%s*:%s*", "exit"}, {"^exit%s*:%s*", "exit"}, {"^doors%s*:%s*", "door"}, {"^door%s*:%s*", "door"}, {"^doors%s+", "door"}, {"^door%s+", "door"} } for _, item in ipairs(patterns) do local stripped, count = text:gsub(item[1], "", 1) if count > 0 then return stripped, item[2] end end return text, nil end
local function is_exit_line(line) local text = clean(line):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local heading text, heading = strip_exit_heading(text) if text == "" then return false end -- A labelled exit/door may have a world-specific name such as portal, -- hatch or trail. Preserve it immediately instead of asking the model to -- guess or silently omit it. if heading then return true end local count = 0 for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do word = word:gsub("^[%[%(%{]+", ""):gsub("[%]%)%},%.]+$", "") if not exit_words[word] then return false end count = count + 1 end return count > 0 end
local exit_labels = { n="北", s="南", e="東", w="西", u="上", d="下", ne="東北", nw="西北", se="東南", sw="西南", north="北", south="南", east="東", west="西", up="上", down="下", northeast="東北", northwest="西北", southeast="東南", southwest="西南", none="無" }
local function exit_history_text(line) local original = clean(line):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local value = original:lower() local heading = "出口：" local heading_kind value, heading_kind = strip_exit_heading(value) if heading_kind == "door" then heading = "門：" end local chinese_parts = {} local english_parts = {} for word in value:gmatch("%S+") do local key = word:gsub("^[%[%(%{]+", ""):gsub("[%]%)%},%.]+$", "") chinese_parts[#chinese_parts + 1] = exit_labels[key] or "特殊出口" english_parts[#english_parts + 1] = key end return heading .. table.concat(chinese_parts, "，") .. "，" .. table.concat(english_parts, "，") end
local flush_pending

-- Expand every bilingual entry into real history rows. This is -- presentation-only: translation output and cache stay untouched. Rows are -- always stored top-to-bottom as one-line English followed by Chinese. This -- gives numpad 7/9 one consistent path for single sentences, rooms and dialog. local function expand_accessible_history_entries(entries) local output = {} for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local zh, en = tostring(entry or ""):match("^(.-)%s+|%s+([%s%S]*)$") if not zh or not en then output[#output + 1] = entry else local dialogue = is_quoted_dialogue(en) if dialogue then local english_line = en:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local chinese_line = zh:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if english_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = english_line end if chinese_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = chinese_line end else local parts = translated_sentence_parts(zh) local wrapped = en:find("[\r\n]") ~= nil if wrapped then local first_en = en:match("^%s*([^\r\n]+)") or "" first_en = first_en:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local first_zh = parts[1] or "" local space_start, space_end = first_zh:find("%s+") if #first_en > 0 and #first_en <= 80 and not first_en:match("[%.%!%?%:%;]$") and space_start and space_start > 1 and space_start <= 120 then local title = first_zh:sub(1, space_start - 1):gsub("%s+$", "") local remainder = first_zh:sub(space_end + 1):gsub("^%s+", "") if title ~= "" and remainder ~= "" then table.remove(parts, 1) table.insert(parts, 1, remainder) table.insert(parts, 1, title) end end end local english_line = en:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if english_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = english_line end for _, part in ipairs(parts) do local line = part:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = line end end end end end return output end
local function write_accessible_history(original, translated, categories, anchor_id) if accessible_history_mode == "off" then return end local entries = collect_accessible_history(original, translated) local function review_kind_for(value, request_categories) value = tostring(value or "") if value:match("^%s*Quest Name:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Magic Quest Name:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Information for quest%s+%d+:%s*") or value:match("^%s*You have discovered or been given the following quests:%s*") or value:match("^%s*There are the following unfinished quests nearby:%s*") or value:match("^%s*.-following quests are available to you at this time:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Sorry, unknown option for 'quest' command%.") then return "quest" end if value:match("^%s*Currently accepted jobs:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Information for job%s+%d+:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Job Name:%s*") then return "job" end if value:match("^%s*You know the following skills:") or value:match("^%s*You have%s+%d+%s+practices?%s+left%.") then return "skills" end for _, category in ipairs(request_categories or {}) do if category == "skills" then return "skills" end end return nil end local review_kind = review_kind_for(original, categories) -- Keep every semantic row bilingual in storage. The NVDA presentation -- layer exposes only the Chinese half while retaining the hidden English -- half. Expanding this into separate English and Chinese history -- rows destroys that relationship and makes pure-English rows visible. if anchor_id then history_insert_before(anchor_id, entries, review_kind) else for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do history_add(entry, review_kind) end end block_diag.history = block_diag.history + #entries end
local function write_fallback_history(req) if not req or not req.original or req.skip_history or accessible_history_mode == "off" then return end local entry = "English fallback: " .. tostring(req.original) local review_kind = nil local value = tostring(req.original or "") if value:match("^%s*Quest Name:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Magic Quest Name:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Information for quest%s+%d+:%s*") or value:match("^%s*You have discovered or been given the following quests:%s*") or value:match("^%s*There are the following unfinished quests nearby:%s*") then review_kind = "quest" elseif value:match("^%s*Currently accepted jobs:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Information for job%s+%d+:%s*") or value:match("^%s*Job Name:%s*") then review_kind = "job" elseif value:match("^%s*You know the following skills:") or value:match("^%s*You have%s+%d+%s+practices?%s+left%.") then review_kind = "skills" else for _, category in ipairs(req.categories or {}) do if category == "skills" then review_kind = "skills"; break end end end if req.history_anchor_id then history_insert_before(req.history_anchor_id, {entry}, review_kind) else history_add(entry, review_kind) end block_diag.history = block_diag.history + 1 end
local function poll_results() -- Poll each outstanding request independently. A lost result must not block -- every later translation. for request_id, req in pairs(requests) do local path = outbox .. "/res_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then
tm_debug("TM RESULT 2: Lua found response " .. tostring(request_id)) local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() tm_debug("TM RESULT 3A: response bytes=" .. tostring(#text) .. " prefix=" .. tostring(text:sub(1,12):gsub("\r","<CR>"):gsub("\n","<LF>"))) os.remove(path)
requests[request_id] = nil
if enabled and req and req.kind == "outgoing_chat" then outgoing_request_id = nil local translated = nil if text:sub(1,4) == "OK\r\n" then translated = text:sub(5) elseif text:sub(1,3) == "OK\n" then translated = text:sub(4) end if not translated or translated == "" then speak("Message translation failed. Original input kept.") elseif tostring(GetCommand() or "") ~= tostring(req.original or "") then speak("Input changed. Translation discarded.") else SetCommandSelection(1, -1) PasteCommand(translated:gsub("[\r\n]+", " ")) local current = tostring(GetCommand() or "") SetCommandSelection(#current + 1, #current) speak("English translation ready. Press Enter to send after checking it.") end elseif enabled then local translated = nil if text:sub(1,4) == "OK\r\n" then translated = text:sub(5) elseif text:sub(1,3) == "OK\n" then translated = text:sub(4) end if translated then tm_debug("TM RESULT 3B: response OK; translated chars/bytes=" .. tostring(#translated)) tm_debug("TM RESULT 4: calling speak()") if req and req.original and not req.skip_history then local history_ok, history_err = pcall(write_accessible_history, req.original, translated, req.categories, req.history_anchor_id) if not history_ok then log("ERROR accessible history Lua failure=" .. tostring(history_err), true) end end local ok, err = pcall(speak, translated, request_id) if ok then tm_debug("TM RESULT 5: speak() returned") else tm_debug("TM RESULT ERROR: speak() failed: " .. tostring(err)) log("ERROR speech queue write failed request=" .. tostring(request_id) .. " error=" .. tostring(err), true) if req and req.original then speak(req.original, request_id) end end else tm_debug("TM RESULT ERROR: response is not OK; falling back to English") log("ERROR malformed or failed translation response request=" .. tostring(request_id), true) if req and req.original then pcall(write_fallback_history, req) speak(req.original, request_id) end end else tm_debug("TM RESULT: response arrived while translation mode disabled") end end end end local function expire_requests() for n,r in pairs(requests) do r.ticks = (r.ticks or 0) + 1 -- 35 seconds at a 100 ms timer. Worker has its own 25-second timeout and returns ERR for English fallback. if r.ticks >= 350 then log("TIMEOUT request=" .. tostring(n), true) if enabled and r.kind == "outgoing_chat" then outgoing_request_id = nil speak("Message translation timed out. Original input kept.") elseif enabled and r.original then pcall(write_fallback_history, r); speak(r.original, n) end requests[n] = nil -- Keep process launch out of the 100 ms TranslationTick. recovery_requested = true end end end
function TranslationTick() touch_session_file() if enabled and #pending > 0 then pending_ticks = pending_ticks + 1 -- Narrative uses 300 ms; plugin Notes use a short 100 ms buffer. if pending_ticks >= pending_target_ticks then flush_pending() end end poll_results() expire_requests() end
function TranslationRecoveryTick() poll_update_notice() if not recovery_requested then return end recovery_requested = false local ok, result = pcall(start_worker) if not ok or not result then log("ERROR worker recovery launch failed=" .. tostring(result), true) end end
function OnPluginClose() set_review_mode_state(false) remove_session_file() end
